[b]The Ultimatium of April 20th, 2028[/b]

[b][sub]Notice for the immeditate consideration of the Romarii Government.[/sub][/b]

From: Acting Secretary of State, Mary Eikelboom

To: Whom it may concern within the Romarii Government

As is my duty as the duly appointed Acting Secretary of State of the United Commonwealth of Wuloosya. I have written to inform you of the final decision of our government regarding your recent atrocities against your own people and acts of colonialism and barbarism. Your government has officially been determined to be a threat to the stability of Vespurias, and the rest of the Erene, economic sanctions and military intervention have already been proposed regarding your actions to both the Elesyeran Defense Union and the International Forum, and regardless of the outcome of these discussions the Government of the United Commonwealth, as approved by an emergency session of our senate has determined towards a military intervention against your nation. We want to present your government with one last chance to do the right thing and comply with the International Convention and ensure continuing and everlasting peace. Failure to comply wth the ultimatum below will result in an immediate initiation of a military intervention against your government aimed at restoring international peace.

Section 1 of the Ultimatium:

The Romarrian Government will destroy all of its Chemical and Biological weapons under the supervision of the International Forum

Section 2 of the Ultimatium: 

All Romarrian military forces will immediately withdraw from their colonial territories, replaced by the WDF, which will head an international force to secure the islands and ensure the installation of a new democratic and free government 

Section 3:

The Romarrian Government will be obligated to pay reparations of at least 100,000 dollars per victim of the attacks to the direct family of those affected, an amount equalling 1.1 billion dollars overall, a detailed apology to the victims, and the establishment of a memorial on the site where such a crime occurred.

Section 4: 

The immediate abdication of the Romarian Monarch, Mario Mario, who shall hand himself over to the International Court of Justice for a trial for crimes against humanity and peace.

Section 5:

Any high-ranking military personnel involved in the massacres should be promptly handed over to the International Court of Justice for a trial.

Section 6:

Romarii will immediately release all claims it holds on the islands and territories not currently controlled by it. Including claims currently held against the sovereign nation of Yuluanburg.
Section 7:

Romarii will permanently drop any future colonial ambitions and not pursue establishing new colonies; doing so will be considered a violation of this ultimatum.

Section 8:

Romarii will submit to a full International Fourm search of military bases to ensure compliance with international law, including ensuring that no chemical weapons are being hidden

Section 9:

All facilities that can produce chemical or Biological weapons must be promptly dismantled

And finally, 

Section 10:

Romarii will submit to the International Forum monitoring of civilian chemical facilities to ensure they are not used to acquire chemical weapons

You will have a total of 10 days to respond to the contents of this ultimatum. Failure to respond will be treated as a rejection of its terms. It should be noted that failure to comply now will result in harsher terms later. 

Truly, Acting Secretary of State Mary Eikelboom

[b]August 9, 2028: Surrender of Belgarde[/b]

Antoine Jacques stood at the window of the ducal palace as he stared out onto the square, where the citizens had gathered to welcome the Sallach Army, which had marched into the city the night before, Lor had fled the day earlier to Mittlemarkke upon hearing word that the soldiers who were travelling to save the city had defected upon crossing the border into Belgarde.

The regime has collapsed, he said aloud to no-one in particular.

Turning away from the window he moved to his desk where he picked up a crumpled piece of paper, it was a surrender speech, he smoothed it out, tapped his cane as he read it, and then walked out onto the balcony overfacing the square where the protestors had gathered.

Citizens of Belgarde, this marks a turning point in Rosenmarkket history, as the old order returns, we must ask ourselves, what next?. It is in this new period that comes upon us like the dawn, that I ask for you to remain loyal to Belgarde, loyal to each-other, and loyal to the nation! Do not allow the government to oppress you, stand up, and act valiantly! Peace! Order! Security! Ariscați-vă, popoare! și luptați pro libertate, pro libertate mare, pro justiție! 

The crowd cheered as Jacques bowed to the crowd, and then left the balcony, moving to the back halls where he would get into a car to meet the leadership of the Sallach armed forces.
